"""Most frequent words."""
import re
from collections import Counter


def top_words(text, k):
    if isinstance(k, bool) or not isinstance(k, int) or k < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"k must be at least 1: {k!r}")
    counts = Counter(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower()))
    ranked = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda p: (-p[1], p[0]))
    return ranked[:k]

cat > tests/test_topwords.py <<'E'
import io
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stderr, redirect_stdout

from textkit.cli import main
from textkit.topwords import top_words


def run(*argv):
    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    with redirect_stdout(out), redirect_stderr(err):
        code = main(list(argv))
    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()


class TopWordsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(top_words("b a b c a b", 2), [("b", 3), ("a", 2)])

    def test_case_and_split(self):
        self.assertEqual(top_words("Don't DON t", 5), [("don", 2), ("t", 2)])

    def test_ties_alphabetical(self):
        self.assertEqual(top_words("c b a", 3), [("a", 1), ("b", 1), ("c", 1)])

    def test_fewer_than_k(self):
        self.assertEqual(top_words("x", 5), [("x", 1)])

    def test_bad_k(self):
        for k in (0, -1):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                top_words("a", k)

    def test_cli(self):
        self.assertEqual(run("top", "b a b c a b", "--k", "2"), (0, "b 3\na 2\n", ""))

    def test_cli_default_k(self):
        self.assertEqual(run("top", "a b c d")[1], "a 1\nb 1\nc 1\n")

    def test_cli_error(self):
        code, out, err = run("top", "x", "--k", "0")
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertTrue(err.startswith("error:"))
